title: Iron Tide
short_description: Call your salvos and sink the enemy fleet in a 3D naval duel.
description: Iron Tide is a 3D naval battleship duel. Place your fleet, then trade salvos with a hunting AI across two side-by-side seas. Sink an enemy ship to earn a one-use upgrade — Recon Scan, Barrage, Salvo, Sonar, or Double Tap — and chain sinks for escalating power. Rotate the camera freely, pick your difficulty, and watch stricken ships founder into burning wrecks that slowly slip beneath the waves.
controls_keyboard: Left-click to place ships / fire · R rotate ship · A auto-place · Right-drag rotate camera · WASD move · scroll zoom · 1-5 abilities · Esc pause
